title: Wonders of Vietnam with FREE Visit to Fansipan Mountain
highlights: Witness Vietnam's vibrant urban life, scenic mountainous landscapes, and serene coastal beauty.
Explore the historic Cat Cat Village in Sa Pa, home to Mong ethnic people, where you can admire terraced fields, and visit the beautiful Cat Cat Waterfall.
Ascend Indochina's highest peak, Fansipan, at 3,147 meters via cable car, and witness the stunning views of the Hoang Lien Son range and valleys below.
Stroll around the Old Quarter in Hanoi and enjoy its lively streets, traditional shops, and delectable street food.
Cruise through the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Halong Bay, exploring emerald waters, limestone karsts, and various fun activities.
inclusions: Transfer from Noi Bai International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
3 nights stay in Hanoi with breakfast
1 night stay in Sa Pa with breakfast
Cat Cat Village Half-day Tour on a Shared basis
Fansipan Mountain Tour on a Shared basis

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi, the vibrant capital of Vietnam! Upon your arrival at Noi Bai International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in the city. Check in and relax for a while, before exploring the place at your own pace. You can visit places like Hoan Kiem Lake, the symbol of Hanoi, and Ngoc Son Temple, famous for its cultural significance. Later, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Sa Pa | Cat Cat Village Tour
days.desc: Begin the day by checking out from the hotel and getting transferred to Sa Pa, located in the Hoang Lien Son Mountains. Upon arrival in Sa Pa, check in at your hotel and board the pre-booked transfer to Cat Cat Village, where you will have a chance to witness the lifestyle of the Black H’mong people. Further, trek to the Tien Sa Waterfall surrounded by lush green forest.  After exploring the place, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fansipan Mountain Tour | Transfer to Hanoi
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel in Sa Pa and begin your day by getting transferred to Fansipan Mountain, the highest peak in Indochina. Enjoy a cable car ride from Hoang Lien station to the Fansipan cable car station. From there, climb 600 stairs to the peak of Fansipan and witness the beautiful Kim Son Bao Thang Temple Afterwards, descend from the mountain and get transferred to Hanoi. Upon reaching Hanoi, check in at the hotel and have an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Halong Royal Palace Overnight Cruise
days.desc: In the morning, check out of your hotel and get transferred to Halong Bay, known for its emerald waters and limestone karsts (rock formations). Upon arrival at the Tuần Châu Harbor, board your cruise and witness the scenic beauty as you sail through the bay. In the afternoon, visit Ti Top Island, and Pearl Farm Village on a boat ride and enjoy water sports like kayaking, snorkelling and many more. In the evening, savour a delicious dinner on board and relax with an overnight stay on the cruise

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the view from the cruise while as you are greeted with a welcome drink. 
You will visit the Ti Top island and enjoy the view of many more of Halong Bay's beautiful islands.
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. 
Return to the cruise and later, join the cooking demonstration on Vietnamese food by a talented chef. 
Enjoy an overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Wake up early to witness a beautiful sunrise over Halong Bay. Enjoy breakfast and go on a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay. After lunch, disembark from the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. You can explore places like the Temple Of Literature, and Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. Later, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi
items.desc:
Enjoy your journey by joining the Tai Chi lesson on the cruise. Explore the other parts and islands of the Halong Bay. 
Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest caves in the Halong Bay and admire it's scenic beauty. 
Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: On this day, check out of your hotel and get transferred to Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flight. Bid farewell to Vietnam, taking with you unforgettable memories of your journey.
